appDescription: Record cargo loaded into the trunk and remind the driver where to unload it. The app confirms changes before saving and can use the active navigation destination.

function.name: REGISTER_TRUNK_CARGO
function.description: Prepare one newly loaded trunk item for driver confirmation from its name and spoken quantity. The intended use, unloading place, and long-term storage preference are optional.

cargo_name.description: The name of the item loaded into the trunk.

quantity.description: The spoken count of items expressed as a whole number from 1 to 999.

purpose.description: The intended use if the driver explicitly provides one.

target_place.description: The unloading place if the driver explicitly specifies it. The app can use the active navigation destination when omitted.

keep_in_car.description: Whether the cargo should remain in the car without destination reminders.

function.name: LIST_TRUNK_CARGO
function.description: Report cargo recorded as remaining in the trunk. Optionally filter by item name or saved unloading destination.

query.description: The cargo name to search for, or an empty string to list all remaining cargo.

target_place.description: An optional unloading destination to match against the saved destination.

function.name: UPDATE_TRUNK_CARGO
function.description: Prepare a cargo update for driver confirmation: record unloading, change the unloading destination, or keep the cargo in the car without arrival reminders.

cargo_name.description: The name of the cargo item.

quantity.description: The whole number actually unloaded. Supply this only for the unload operation.

cargo_id.description: The identifier of a specific cargo record when multiple records have the same name.

operation.description: Use unload for removed cargo, change_destination for a new unloading destination, or keep_in_car for permanent storage.

existing_target_place.description: The old unloading destination, useful to distinguish records with the same cargo name.

target_place.description: The new unloading destination. Supply this only for the change_destination operation.
